# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server, 2026-10-16: client-probes/probe_pronebones
# with probe_spot flat on mp_carentan, one prone client, placed twice. Each PROBE

# pose it shows. The FALL lines are the client's snapshots whose prone body
